topPick.thesis: Allstate (ALL) is trading at 5.8x P/E, a 64% discount to its sector average of 16.2x; RSI at 59 reflects healthy bullish momentum without overextension. Three-month price momentum of +22.6% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +338% year-on-year, underpinned by a bullish MACD crossover confirming upward price pressure. Composite score of 77/100 places ALL in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +12.5% over the past quarter.
